messages:
Nia (CS): FYI incoming from Seabright Transport — they want to onboard a domain-specific NER model for driver manifests. Customer insists on on-prem bare-metal deployment behind their firewall, HSM for keys, and minimal telemetry. Can @Omar and @Priya triage feasibility + timelines?
legal-bot: New intake created: SB-ONB-1108 by Nia (CS) — tag: onprem-hsm
Omar (ML Eng): On-prem + HSM is doable but adds setup time. Quick clarifying Qs: are they shipping a full PyTorch checkpoint or a TRT/ONNX artifact? Also what's their throughput expectation (rps) and latency p95 target?
Nia (CS): They will ship a fine-tuned checkpoint (PyTorch, 13B family). Expectation: p95 latency <= 250ms for single-request NER, and sustained 15 rps during peak. They said renewal evaluation next quarter; slow onboarding could jeopardize expansion.
Priya (Solutions): For on-prem bare-metal we need an install window and access to a staging box for canary. Recommend dedicated machine class (4xA100 or equivalent) and containerized runtime. I'll draft an install checklist and pricing for a managed on-prem engagement. Need sample dataset and preferred retention/telemetry policy.
Tomas (Security): HSM + BYOK noted. We'll require an attestation for the appliance and a secure keywrap flow. Also need to confirm whether we can collect anonymized telemetry for perf debugging; customer says minimal, but an opt-in ephemeral path might be acceptable.
Nia (CS): Customer prefers zero retention for request/response bodies; ok with aggregated metrics (cpu/gpu/latency) only. They also asked for an eval plan to validate PHI masking and false positive/negative risk.
Omar (ML Eng): Proposed eval plan: 1) run PHI-leak detection scans (regex + model hallucination probes), 2) entity-level metrics across driver manifests: precision/recall/F1, 3) poisoning check and sample inference consistency tests. Request initial labeled sample: 400 examples (target 1k after first pass). Success criteria: F1 >= 0.84 and PHI leakage rate ~0.
Priya (Solutions): Timeline impact: install + security signoffs ~10 business days after we receive appliance access + keys. Canary perf run needs a 2-hour maintenance window on their staging net. I'll include that in the SOW.
legal-bot: Auto-note: For on-prem with PHI, change request: executed BAA + technical addendum required. Also need to confirm data jurisdiction and subcontractor clauses.
Tomas (Security): Also request their internal SOC/IT contact for firewall rules and jumpbox creation. We'll supply an access checklist (SSH CA, ephemeral certs, audit logging to their SIEM).
Nia (CS): Customer available for kickoff Thurs 9am CET. @Priya can you lead the onboarding call? I'll send invite and attach the intake form and secure upload instructions.
Priya (Solutions): Thurs 9am CET works. I'll lead. Drafting an intake checklist now — will post link here. Quick sample model config I'll share during the call:
```yaml
model: seabright-13b-ner
deployment: onprem-baremetal
hsm: true
keys: BYOK
p95_latency_ms: 250
throughput_rps: 15
telemetry: aggregated-only
retention: minimal
```
Omar (ML Eng): After they upload the sample I'll run quantization compatibility checks (4-bit/8-bit), a small end-to-end perf sweep, and the PHI leakage probes. If F1 < 0.84, we recommend a relabel & retrain iteration.
Nia (CS): Recap action items: Priya 1 — SOW + install checklist + calendar invite; Omar 1 — eval plan + reserve canary slot; Tomas 1 1 security access checklist + keywrap instructions; Nia 1 customer comms + collect SOC contact + jurisdiction.
Priya (Solutions): I'll also attach the managed on-prem pricing tiers and a rough timeline. Posting the checklist shortly. :spiral_calendar:
Nia (CS): Thanks team. Seabright flagged renewal as a gating item for a multi-account roll-out, so let's prioritize this. If anyone needs escalations, DM me and I'll pull in AM.
